title: PH60112: Ferroelectrics And Dielectrics
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Linear and non-linear dielectric, piezo-, pyro- and ferroelectric crystals;
structural phase transition. Dipole and thermodynamical theory of orderdisorder and displacive type of phase transition. Structural, dielectric,
electrical, spectroscopic and optical properties of ferroelectrics.
Ferroelectric devices. Electro-optic modulator, light valves, pyroelectric
detectors, transducers, computer memory and display devices, non-volatile
devices.
